prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an entirely original NU MOU CHEMIST character for a Final Fantasy Tactics Advance GBA expansion. Match FFTA Nu Mou anatomy faithfully: short stocky hunched body, large pale beige/gray furry head, elongated rounded drooping snout, very long soft ears hanging at the sides, gentle small eyes, short arms and broad little feet. Not a human, not a rabbit-person, not a Moogle, no pompom/wings. New costume drawn from scratch: protective brass brow goggles above the eyes, a compact muted-blue work tunic, cream short apron, brown leather reagent satchel at the hip, three readable red/green/amber potion bottles in a harness and simple soft shoes. Keep the face, snout and ears unobstructed; bags must fit the Nu Mou's rounded anatomy. Distinct alchemist/chemist silhouette, no mage hat, no reskin of a White Mage or Alchemist. Original FFTA tiny isometric chibi pixel art with large carefully placed square pixel clusters, colored dark outlines, at most15 flat shared colors and simple2-shade materials. Each figure should read at24pixels wide by28pixels high on32x32 native canvas, enlarged cleanly for display, not a detailed illustration with pixel texture. Square transparent sheet with two columns and two rows, four full figures. LEFT column front three-quarter facing viewer's left. RIGHT column back three-quarter facing away toward viewer's right. TOP row relaxed idle pose. BOTTOM row same views in a second subtle idle pose, a slight weight shift and droop of the satchel. Same character/costume/palette/scale; large transparent margins in each equal cell, all snouts, ears, bags and feet inside the cell. No background, shadows, glow, gradients, smoothing, labels, numbers, text, grid or watermark. Truly transparent alpha background. Only canonical front/back views; the native game mirror system supplies opposite directions.
